The `wrap-*.json` fixtures preserve complete native composer rows from unsent
pastes at pane widths 64, 80 and 112 on 15 November 2026. The input is synthetic;
headers, model/status lines and workspace furniture are invented. Trailing spaces
inside the box are measured padding. No turn was submitted. The private server
was closed and its disposable home removed after measurement.

The matching fixtures under Codex 0.169.0 and pi 0.79.0 were captured by the
same procedure. Claude Code keeps a short hyphenated word whole
and hard-splits a word longer than its text area. Codex can break at a hyphen; pi wraps at whitespace and hard-splits overlong words. Grok was not
measured because its pool was spent. These captures do not establish Grok's rule.

OpenCode 1.19.5 was also measured: a fresh home draws a centred composer whose
text widths are 55/70/70 at panes 64/80/112, while its current declaration gives
57/73/105. Those captures are reserved for the separate OpenCode geometry fix.
